paragraphs: Volkswagen is planning to cut tens of thousands of jobs and potentially close European factories because its traditional business model is no longer working.

CEO Oliver Blume emphasizes that building cars in Germany for global export has become inefficient due to a declining Chinese market, high regulatory burdens, and competition from aggressive Chinese manufacturers.

VW’s previous efficiency plans from 2024 are no longer sufficient to protect its market share. Meanwhile, Chinese carmakers have captured a record 10% of the European market. They successfully bypassed the EU’s 2024 tariffs on fully electric vehicles by shifting their focus to hybrid models.

To protect domestic automakers, European politicians are currently discussing the Industrial Accelerator Act. This legislation could introduce new tariffs on hybrids or enforce Made in Europe requirements, which would compel foreign companies to manufacture their vehicles locally within Europe. This trend is already seen in recent partnership deals in Spain.

paragraphs: Volkswagen, Europe’s biggest carmaker, wants to cut tens of thousands of jobs and may close some factories. The company’s CEO, Oliver Blume, says their old business model of making cars in Germany for global export doesn’t work anymore.

Volkswagen is losing customers in China, and European buyers are spending less money. At the same time, Chinese car companies are growing fast and now hold over 10% of the European market. To avoid high European import taxes on electric cars, Chinese companies started selling more hybrid cars instead.
To protect European companies, the EU is now planning new laws. These rules might put taxes on hybrid cars or make foreign companies to build their vehicles inside Europe.

paragraphs: Volkswagen is a very big car company in Europe. But it has large problems. The boss of the company wants to close factories and cut thousands of jobs.

Making cars in Germany is now too expensive. Volkswagen is losing money in China. At the same time, Chinese car companies are selling many new cars in Europe. They now have 10% of the European market. They sell popular hybrid cars.
European leaders want to help their car companies. They are talking about new rules. They want taxes on Chinese hybrid cars. The plan is to make these companies build cars inside Europe.
